channel.title: MC Joint — Music, Talent & Cinema
channel.description: News, projects and updates from MC Joint — Hyderabad's creative agency for music distribution, talent management and Telugu cinema strategy.

item.title: Viral Video — Debut Directorial by Prashanth Podagatlapalli | MC Joint
item.description: Viral Video is the debut directorial feature film by MC Joint writer-director Prashanth Podagatlapalli. Currently in post-production. Cast: Pooja Bhavani, Feroze MNA, Laxman Meesala, Muni Myatari. Music: Ravi Nidamarthy. Editor: Rohit Penumatsa.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Gopi Galla Goa Trip — Avanti Cinema's Rural Telangana Comedy (2025)
item.description: Gopi Galla Goa Trip is a rural Telangana adventure-comedy directed by Rohit Penumatsa and Camp Sasi, starring Ajith Mohan as Gopi. Produced by Avanti Cinema and represented by MC Joint.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Sheeshmahal — A Decade in the Making | Avanti Cinema × MC Joint
item.description: Sheeshmahal is a landmark Telugu film by Avanti Cinema, directed by Rohit Penumatsa and Camp Sasi, with music by Vivek Sagar. A decade in the making — distributed and strategised by MC Joint.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Beyond Physical — Documentary Series Directed by Prashanth Podagatlapalli
item.description: Beyond Physical is a Flintstory-produced documentary series directed by Prashanth Podagatlapalli, covering parkour, boxing, BMX cycling and other fitness disciplines.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Avanti Cinema — Six Years of Independent Telugu Storytelling
item.description: A retrospective on Avanti Cinema's six-year journey — from Pickpocket to Sheeshmahal and beyond. MC Joint's longest-standing creative partnership in Telugu independent cinema.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Nalgonda Gaddar Narsanna — The Voice That Crossed Every Stage in 2023
item.description: How Nalgonda Gaddar Narsanna's folk songs resonated across both Telugu states during the 2023 elections — lending his voice to winning and losing sides alike. MC Joint has represented him since late 2021.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Avanti Cinema Transformation — How Rohit Penumatsa and Camp Sasi Built Their World
item.description: The story of how Rohit Penumatsa and Camp Sasi built Avanti Cinema into one of Telugu independent cinema's most distinctive creative voices, and how MC Joint helped shape their strategy.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Tapeloop Records — Vivek Sagar's Music Distribution Revolution
item.description: How MC Joint partnered with Vivek Sagar and Tapeloop Records to build a distribution infrastructure for independent Telugu cinema music — treating every soundtrack with major-label rigour.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Story Discussion Season 2 — Smaran and the Art of Authentic Storytelling
item.description: Story Discussion Season 2 with Smaran — MC Joint's deep-dive series on storytelling craft in Telugu independent cinema.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint
